$comment: Meal arrangements. `coverage` is the whole model: 'included' = fully covered (breakfast in the room rate), 'capped' = covered by the Federation up to allowance.perService, 'own' = the guest pays. `venue` must match a venue id in guide.json and `date` must fall inside meta.dates.

headline.en: the covered amount per person, per service
headline.es: the covered amount por persona, por servicio

body.en: The Federation covers up to the covered amount per lunch and up to the covered amount per dinner, as a maximum per service, on every day of your stay until you check out. It is a ceiling, not a credit: what you don't spend does not carry over to the next meal.
body.es: La Federación asume hasta the covered amount por servicio de almuerzo y hasta the covered amount por servicio de cena, como tope máximo, todos los días de su estadía hasta su check-out. Es un tope, no un saldo: lo que no se consume no se acumula para la siguiente comida.

excludes.en: Alcoholic drinks are not included in the the covered amount and are charged to you, whatever the total of the meal.
excludes.es: Las bebidas alcohólicas no están incluidas en los the covered amount y se cargan al huésped, sea cual sea el total de la comida.

overage.en: Anything above the covered amount in a single service, and any extra consumption, is paid directly by the guest.
overage.es: Todo lo que exceda los the covered amount en un mismo servicio, y cualquier consumo adicional o extra, lo asume directamente cada huésped.

scope.en: Every day of your stay, up to and including your check-out day.
scope.es: Todos los días de su estadía, hasta el día de su check-out inclusive.

title.en: the covered amount per lunch, the covered amount per dinner
title.es: the covered amount por almuerzo, the covered amount por cena

body.en: The Federation assumes up to the covered amount per service for lunch and the covered amount per service for dinner, as a maximum, for every day you are in the hotel until check-out. You order normally and sign; the amount up to that ceiling is charged to the Federation.
body.es: La Federación asume un consumo de hasta the covered amount por servicio de almuerzo y the covered amount por servicio de cena, como tope máximo, por cada día que estén en el hotel hasta el check-out. Ustedes piden normalmente y firman; el monto hasta ese tope se carga a la Federación.

body.en: The arrangement runs to the day you leave — guests departing earlier stop then, and guests staying to 19 August keep it until that day. Meals after check-out are your own.
body.es: El esquema rige hasta el día en que se van — quienes salgan antes lo tienen hasta ese día, y quienes se queden hasta el 19 de agosto lo mantienen hasta esa fecha. Las comidas posteriores al check-out son por su cuenta.

body.en: The the covered amount does not cover alcoholic drinks. They go on your personal bill even when the food is well under the ceiling.
body.es: Los the covered amount no cubren bebidas alcohólicas. Van a su cuenta personal incluso si la comida quedó muy por debajo del tope.

title.en: Extras and the card at check-in
title.es: Extras y la tarjeta en el check-in

body.en: At check-in the hotel asks for a credit card as a guarantee for personal consumption. If you prefer not to leave one, the hotel charges each extra at the moment you order it, as it does with any guest.
body.es: En el check-in el hotel solicita una tarjeta de crédito en garantía para cubrir los consumos personales. Si prefieren no dejarla, el hotel cobra cada extra al momento del consumo, como es su proceso regular.

body.en: Breakfast is included in the room rate and does not touch the the covered amount lunch or dinner ceiling. Give your room number.
body.es: El desayuno está incluido en la tarifa de la habitación y no consume el tope de the covered amount del almuerzo ni de la cena. Indiquen su número de habitación.

title.es: La cena de gala es ofrecida

body.en: Thursday 13 August at Restaurant Huaca Pucllana is an invitation from the Federation's President and sits outside the the covered amount arrangement entirely. Departure 19:00, dinner 19:30, smart casual.
body.es: El jueves 13 de agosto en el Restaurant Huaca Pucllana es una invitación de la Presidente de la Federación y queda completamente fuera del esquema de the covered amount. Salida 19:00, cena 19:30, casual elegante.

title.en: Where the the covered amount is valid
title.es: Dónde vale el tope de the covered amount

body.en: Tell the welcome desk in advance. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and allergy plates are arranged with the hotel kitchen and with the gala restaurant.
body.es: Avisen con anticipación en la mesa de bienvenida. Los platos vegetarianos, veganos, sin gluten y por alergias se coordinan con la cocina del hotel y con el restaurante de la gala.
